title: Edgar Mitchell's ESP experiment on Apollo 14
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Edgar Mitchell's ESP experiment on Apollo 14, about 1971 at The Moon, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Apollo 14, en route to the Moon

tellings.quote: On his journey to the moon, Mitchell conducted a private ESP or extrasensory perception experiment, attempting to send mental images back to Earth using a set of cards.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut on Apollo 14, the 1971 NASA mission to the Moon, ran a private ESP experiment on the way there, ESP meaning extrasensory perception, or sensing things with the mind alone. According to Michels, Mitchell tried to send mental images of a set of cards back to Earth, and he cites a 1971 New York Times interview, telling it as part of a story about NASA's interest in unusual science.
